source.method: Actual muted video reviewed with timestamped 8–10 fps captures and finer frame comparison around overlapping openings. No reference audio copied.
notes: P5182 and Pyro Pilot artwork/25 shots on original video match the catalog; current maker URL retains former Top Maverick wording but code and UPC agree.
First five bursts only. Later close rising clusters and overlapping finale need independent component/timing review; full video inspected but those parts are not filled by repetition.
One apparent origin; no cuts or speed change inside the selected window.

profiles.name: Wild West
profiles.summary: Red bouquets, bright white stars and blue pearls lead into twisting multicolor tails with sharp reports. Crackling bouquets close the sequence.

source.method: Actual muted video reviewed with timestamped 8–10 fps captures and finer frame comparison around overlapping openings. No reference audio copied.
notes: Individual Brothers BP2924 25-shot cake and approved package match; not the four-cake assortment.
Five groups of five: red bouquets, white bouquets, blue stars, low rising multicolor spinners with reports, then crackling bouquets. The fourth group is not five spherical explosions.
One apparent firing area, continuous source timer, no internal edit or speed change observed. Last embers extinguish before the outro around 31.5 s.
Spiral radius and the lower height of the fourth group are illustrative visual geometry. Source launch and report timing retained separately.

profiles.name: Dreams from Heaven
profiles.summary: Green stars and red points open in changing ring-like shapes, followed by blue pearls and gold branches with colored tips.

source.method: Actual muted video reviewed with timestamped 8–10 fps captures and finer frame comparison around overlapping openings. No reference audio copied.
notes: Exact Raccoon RA22010, 25-shot cake, approved artwork and UPC 757201220101.
Eighteen individually resolved openings are retained, ending before the overlapping crackling finale near 30.4 s. The reference does not resolve all 25 centers, so no missing shots are synthesized.
Whole 35.121 s reference inspected. One apparent origin, no speed change observed; variable ring perspectives are illustrative. The final cluster is not miscounted as each of its crackling flowers.
